sources.source: GEO 2024 Political Activity and Lobbying Report
sources.scope: Corporate and GEO PAC aggregate contributions by recipient category
sources.key_evidence: Federal/National Committees: GEO PAC $225,000; Corporate $2,150,000. National 527: Corporate $515,000.
sources.visual_qa: PDF page 6 of the file (printed page -5-) visibly confirms Corporate Committees $2,150,000 and the separate Corporate 527 row $515,000.
sources.limitation: Unaudited aggregate report; no recipient-level corporate ledger.

sources.source: FEC processed Schedule A recipient receipts
sources.scope: 2024 and 2025 actual receipt dates; contributor-name searches for GEO and named subsidiaries; Florida/Boca Raton organization filters; latest processed amendments
sources.limitation: Recipient-reported data may abbreviate or misidentify the payer; differently named affiliates outside the tested universe may remain.

sources.scope: Committee type and federal registration for all included recipients
sources.result: All included recipients are FEC-registered federal committees. No included recipient is a state/local-only committee or an IRS 527-only organization.

sources.source: FEC processed Schedule B recipient disbursements/refunds
sources.scope: Exact GEO-named payees/refund recipients for every included committee
sources.result: No exact GEO-named refund or reversal found in the searched recipient committee Schedule B records.
sources.limitation: The FEC name filter is fuzzy; result was post-filtered to exact THE GEO/GEO prefixes. Absence does not prove no off-ledger repayment.

sources.source: GEO PAC Schedule B and committee totals
sources.scope: Disambiguation of recipient-abbreviated corporate names and testing of PAC-labeled anomalous receipts
results: Matched the $1,000 Tom Barrett receipt to GEO PAC's 2024 check.
Matched the $25,000 Advance the Senate receipt to GEO PAC contributor ID C00382150 and Schedule B check.
Matched the $1,000 Lance Gooden receipt to GEO PAC's same-date 2025 check.
Found no matching GEO PAC Schedule B disbursement to Trump Vance Inaugural Committee for the $500,000 Form 13 receipt.
Found no matching GEO PAC Schedule B disbursement to American Liberty Foundation for the $250,000 PAC-labeled line-17 receipt.
sources.limitation: An unmatched recipient label does not authorize reassignment to corporate treasury.

sources.source: Trump Vance Inaugural Committee amended FEC Form 13
sources.result: Reports THE GEO GROUP, INC. POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE, $500,000, received 2024-12-11, transaction F132.147237991.
sources.visual_qa: PDF page 279 of 327 visibly shows THE GEO GROUP, INC. POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE, 4955 Technology Way, receipt date 12/11/2024, amount $500,000, and transaction F132.147237991.
sources.classification: Inaugural donation reported on Form 13, not a federal campaign contribution.
sources.limitation: Recipient donor label conflicts with the absence of a matching GEO PAC Schedule B disbursement; payer stream unresolved and excluded from the corporate denominator.

sources.scope: Processed Schedule A contributor-name universe for GEO corporate variants in 2024
sources.result: No eligible GEO corporate Form 4 host- or convention-committee receipt appeared in the retrieved GEO recipient universe.
sources.limitation: Bounded by tested legal names and processed FEC data.

sources.source: GEO company disclosure of National 527 organizations
sources.scope: Republican Governors Association; Republican Attorneys General Association; GOPAC; Republican State Leadership Committee
sources.result: Company reports separate corporate 527 totals of $515,000 for 2024 and $450,000 for 2025, without recipient-level amounts.
sources.treatment: Excluded from the Federal/National Committees denominators. IRS 527/8872 recipient-level allocation was not used to force either reconciliation because the company explicitly separates the bucket and does not publish the allocation.

not_applicable_or_excluded_streams: Employee-funded GEO PAC contributions except as disambiguation cross-checks
National 527 organizations reported in a separate GEO row
Host/convention donations reported on Form 4 unless a GEO corporate row was located
unresolved_primary_source_need: GEO's recipient-level corporate treasury ledger, bank/check register, general-ledger coding, or an attested schedule mapping each 2024 and 2025 payment to the company's report categories.
